data.one_liner: Provides pre-made custom clippers for various shapes in Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies a collection of pre-defined CustomClipper classes such as waves, diagonals, arrows, stars, and polygons. Developers can pass these clippers directly to Flutter's ClipPath or ClipOval widgets to achieve custom visual shapes without writing custom path geometry from scratch.
use_when: You need standard decorative shapes like waves, diagonal cuts, or banners in your UI.
You want to save time avoiding manual Path calculations for common layout clipping tasks.
avoid_when: You require highly complex, custom geometric animations that are entirely unique to your app.
You only need basic geometric clipping like circles or rectangles that Flutter provides out of the box.
strengths: Provides a wide variety of ready-to-use custom shapes and clippers.
Simple integration with standard Flutter ClipPath widgets.
weaknesses: Limited to the specific pre-defined shapes included in the package.
Does not provide interactive or gesture-driven shape modifications.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.
data.minimal_example:
ClipPath(
  clipper: WaveClipperOne(),
  child: Container(
    height: 120,
    color: Colors.deepPurple,
    child: Center(child: Text("WaveClipperOne()")),
  ),
)
